_readme: Casting and direction for tools/voice_tts.js (Gemini TTS gemini-3.8-flash-tts). Speaker ids = tools/voice_script.js SPEAKERS.

voice: a prebuilt voice id from GET /v1beta/voices (type prebuilt → speechConfig.voiceConfig.prebuiltVoiceConfig.voiceName) or a custom replicated voice (type custom → speechConfig.voiceConfig.voice).
profile/style go into the prompt (English); lines[<id>] is the per-line acting direction; fx is a post effect of tools/voice_tts.js (FX table: pitch / echo).
hero: the silent protagonist only has short battle voices, one set per gender (R.State.hero().gender m/f): v_hero_<g>_<kind>_<n>, played by R.Audio.battleVoice(kind).

Hero voices: the male hero uses the custom voice Signature Voice (median F0 ≈ 139 Hz). Both custom voices read as adult male, so the female hero was recast (2026-09-26) to the prebuilt ja-jp-assistant-4 (female, 22, Tokyo; auditioned against ja-jp-training-6 / ja-jp-commercial-6): median F0 of her 12 clips ≈ 309 Hz vs 216 Hz for the male set (calm lines ≈ 180–210 Hz vs ≈ 124 Hz).
readings[<id>]: what the TTS is asked to say instead of the script text, for words it misreads (the check still compares with the script).

fine.profile: Fine, a girl who looks about 15 in a grey hooded cloak; in truth the first storyteller from a thousand years ago. Quiet, clear, gentle, a little old-fashioned; her body is fading.
fine.style: soft and clear young female voice, calm and mysterious, never loud; tender pauses

rowell.profile: Rowell, a 20-year-old male archivist of the Archive and the hero's rival. Stiff, proud and sarcastic at first; later full of doubt, then a loyal ally.
rowell.style: young male voice, crisp and cool, clipped sentences; emotions break through in later scenes

berna.profile: Berna, a storyteller woman of about 70, the hero's mentor who raised the hero. Soft, warm and a little mischievous grandmother.
berna.style: elderly female voice, warm and gentle with a playful smile, relaxed pace

lazaro.profile: Lazaro, the 60-year-old Grand Scribe of the Archive, the final human antagonist. Always polite and calm; lost his daughter Mira in a war twenty years ago.
lazaro.style: mature male voice, soft-spoken, very polite, chilling calm; grief underneath

king.profile: The Hollow King, primordial oblivion itself and the last boss. Nameless, formless, vast and cold.
king.style: deep, slow, inhuman male voice full of contempt; heavy and resonant

nemrea.profile: Nemrea, the Hollow King after being called by its true name for the first time: fading into sleep, surprised, at peace. Ageless and androgynous.
nemrea.style: soft androgynous voice, breathy, slow, filled with wonder, almost childlike

noa.profile: Noa, a woman in her thirties in Biblia, a city that is forgetting everything; the childhood friend of Mira. Gentle, kind, a little sad.
noa.style: gentle adult female voice, soft and warm, sad undertone

valzard.profile: The lingering shadow of the legendary demon lord Valzard, feared and forgotten for three hundred years.
valzard.style: deep gravelly male voice, slow and heavy, weary dread, echoing

elm.profile: Elm, the ancient lord of the forest who dwells in a thousand-year-old tree. Calm, old and wise; remorseful, then grateful.
elm.style: deep, textured, resonant old male voice, slow and solemn

hazal.profile: Hazal, a desert king sealed in his tomb whose name was forgotten; anguished, then relieved when the name returns.
hazal.style: regal male voice, hoarse and dry, anguished then relieved

giant.profile: The ice giant guarding the white dragon's peak: enormous, slow, threatening.
giant.style: deep booming male voice, slow and heavy

neve.profile: Neve, the noble white dragon (female) of the frozen peak. Majestic and cold at first, then warm and grateful.
neve.style: low, majestic mature female voice, dignified and resonant

melda.profile: Melda, the ghost of the kind witch who once owned the misty manor. Elegant mature woman, gentle and melancholic.
melda.style: elegant gentle female voice, soft and wistful

mistwitch.profile: The mist-eater monster imitating the witch Melda's shape and voice to lure children; broken, creepy syllables.
mistwitch.style: eerie, whispering, broken syllables with unnatural pauses

marina.profile: Marina, a very old woman of a cape village who has waited sixty years for her beloved captain's ship to come home.
marina.style: frail elderly female voice, tender and tearful, slow

glen.profile: Captain Glen, the ghost of a sea captain in his forties who forgot his way home; rough seaman, anguished, then tender.
glen.style: rough, warm male voice of a seaman; confused anguish, then tenderness

guardian.profile: The Iron Warden, an ancient iron golem guarding the mine by a pact with the smith god. Heavy, stern, metallic.
guardian.style: deep stern male voice, slow and heavy, mechanical weight

sentinel.profile: The Celestial Sentinel, an ancient star-orrery automaton speaking in broken mechanical syllables.
sentinel.style: flat, monotone, robotic, evenly spaced syllables

profile.m: The hero, a young apprentice storyteller (male) who never speaks in the story; only battle cries.
profile.f: The hero, a young woman of about 18, an apprentice storyteller (female voice); brave but warm, bright and clear. She never speaks in the story; only battle cries.

hero.style: young, bright, determined hero; short energetic battle voice

attack.note: sharp attack shout on a sword swing, short and powerful
fierce shout, putting full strength into the blow

glimmer.note: a sharp inhale, then sudden inspiration: a new technique flashes into mind; excited, bright
a flash of insight in battle, focused then decisive

spell.note: casting a spell, calling on the power of words, confident and ringing
releasing a spell with conviction, strong

hurt.note: taking a hit, short pained grunt

ko.note: collapsing in battle, weak, fading breath

victory.note: relieved and happy after winning a battle, bright
